text:
Nina (product): Heads up 10am PT sync outcome: we launch webinar page at noon. Need a concise SEO tidy-up checklist so ops can push immediately after deploy. 48h monitoring window.

Diego (seo): Key asks: 1) permanent redirects from legacy promo pages -> /webinar-may-2026 2) ensure canonical on the new page points to itself 3) add Event JSON-LD and BreadcrumbList 4) anchor/related links to signal topic clusters.

Hannah Lee: I'll update the blog CTAs and header banner links to point to the new URL. Also will change the internal anchor text to include "inference benchmarks" to match keyword target.

Tom S.: For eng: what's exact list of old paths? include any vanity URLs we put in marketing emails.

Nina (product): Old paths: /launchs/ai-serving, /events/live-inference, /promo/webinar-preview, plus short link redir /r/wd-infer (email va). Keep utm_source and utm_medium, strip legacy id and session params.

Tom S.: Draft nginx snippet for staging: ```# redirect legacy promo
location = /launchs/ai-serving { return 301 https://redwood.inference/webinar-may-2026?$query_string; }
rewrite ^/promo/webinar-preview(.*)$ /webinar-may-2026$1 permanent; # preserves qs
location = /r/wd-infer { return 302 https://redwood.inference/webinar-may-2026; } # shortlink temporary redirect managed by marketing
```

Diego (seo): Note: convert /r shortlink to 301 after email window closes (7 days). For wildcard email params, preserve utm_campaign but drop legacy_param_x.

deploy-bot: Staging deploy scheduled: 2026-05-12T03:30:00Z. Notify channel when redirects land.

Hannah Lee: JSON-LD draft (place in <head> of new landing): ```{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Inference: Serving at Scale Webinar","startDate":"2026-05-12T17:00:00Z","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.inference/webinar-may-2026"},"organizer":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"}}``` I'll add BreadcrumbList snippet too.

Diego (seo): QA steps post-deploy: run a site crawl to confirm 301s, run Structured Data Testing Tool for Event + Breadcrumb, check canonical tag, run internal link report to ensure 10+ links from high-value pages, confirm GA goals fire for lead form with utm capture.

Tom S.: Eng will include rollback: comment out redirect block + reload nginx, and purge fastly edge cache. I'll add actions to PR.

Nina (product): Owners: redirects=Tom, anchors/H1 updates=Hannah, schema/structured data=Diego, monitoring/alerts=ops. We'll do a quick channel post after staging deploy and a 48h report.

Diego (seo): Also recommend a small A/B for CTA text: "Watch: Serving at Scale" vs "See our latency & cost benchmarks". Track CTR and conversions for 72h.

Hannah Lee: I'll push the anchor text spreadsheet to the content drive and tag folks.

Nina (product): Thanks everyone. Keep changes minimal to reduce index churn. We'll delay any canonical bulk changes for 72h as a safety buffer. :white_check_mark:
